page.overview:
Who is Stansen?

Stansen is a giant from Elbaph and shipwright. A childhood friend of Hajrudin's, they sailed together in their youth.

Two years ago, Stansen was imprisoned in the Auction House, until he was freed alongside other slaves by Silvers Rayleigh during the Straw Hat Pirates' assault on the business. He later rejoined with Hajrudin and his New Giant Warrior Pirates as their shipwright, working as an S-Class soldier in Buggy's Delivery until Hajrudin swore loyalty to Monkey D. Luffy, when they left the organization.

He is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Elbaph Arc.

As a giant, Stansen is much larger than a human. He is rather portly, though has muscular arms, a black beard, a thin mustache, and a crescent scar under his right eye. He wears a hat with flaps on the sides, a leather armband on each arm, and jeans. When confronted by Imu, he lost his right leg.
